item.title: Tate McRae Stars in Adidas’ New Originals Sport Collection Inspired by the Superstar Tracksuit
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest fashion and lifestyle news. Today, we're talking about Adidas' newest addition to their Originals line: Originals Sport, a women's collection that blends performance technology with streetwear style.
[Upbeat music continues to play in the background]
Host: Inspired by the iconic Superstar tracksuit, Originals Sport features a range of pieces, from bras and leggings to onesies and layering items, all designed for versatile styling beyond the gym. The collection debuted in New York City on July 22 and is now available online.
[Campaign music plays]
Host: The campaign stars Tate McRae, Emilia Mernes, and volleyball player Harper Murray, showcasing Adidas' vision of women who move between sport, music, and culture. The collection updates classic Adidas Originals signatures with feminine silhouettes and performance features like Climacool, AdiSoft, and LYCRA Adaptiv.
[Product music plays]
Host: Some standout pieces from the collection include the Adidas Originals Sport Medium Support Bra, which features a streamlined bonded fit and breathable Climacool technology. Then there are the Adidas Originals Sport Superstar 7/8 Leggings, which combine CLIMACOOL comfort with Adimove 3.0 fabric for a soft and supportive feel.
[Quick music transition]
Host: You can also check out the Adidas Originals Sport Shorts, which are designed for everything from workouts to weekend errands. And for a sleek, one-piece essential, there's the Adidas Originals Sport Onesie, which combines a fitted design with performance-focused details.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's it for today's episode. Adidas Originals Sport is now available online, and you can check out the collection through the links on our website. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
